inspection: The benefit rises monotonically with context, proving serialized elementwise exp/normalization was real, but it accounts for only 7.171% of 16K complete-stage last-window service. The candidate still misses both the 2.00x terminal-ratio and 70% throughput-retention bands.
bottleneck: The remaining dominant context term is the pair of O(T*K) score and weighted-value cache scans. The easy elementwise softmax scheduling change cannot materially resolve complete-stage scaling by itself.
decision: REVERT the H014-033d scheduling change under its preregistered 10% retention threshold. Keep H014-033c's capacity-checked 16K mechanism and treat the scan kernels as the next evidence-backed optimization target only if the capacity model shows material fleet impact.
redesign: Promote no new arithmetic optimization. Run P0/P1 regressions on H014-033c, then use measured Gated-MLA context service in the validated capacity model.
